At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

One workflow we would pilot with defence logistics administration teams:

Defence logistics administration
  Delegated: Coordinate administrative inventory records, maintenance paperwork and routine supply requests.
  Stays with you: The institution retains operational authority and controls access to restricted information.
  Exception: An incoming routine supply record has no matching receipt.

The page shows how that exception is handled and which records prove the case is complete.
